verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a broad programmatic surface: an Agent API with web-grounded, cited answers and multi-turn context, a Search API, embeddings, a sandbox tool, an OpenAPI spec, and an MCP server that exposes Computer's browsing, code execution and 400+ connectors. Several UI features, however, have no API equivalent in the evidence, so parity is only partly shown. missing for 10: API equivalents for Library, Discover, Voice, Labs, the Assistant's email and scheduling actions, and Deep Research; an explicit parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call, and conversation context across turns.
Through the Model Context Protocol, your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
Get raw, ranked web search results with advanced filtering and real-time data.
**Connect to 400+ services** through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth
